from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/lifecycle-ci-20261007")
def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)

print("branch="+run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip())
print("head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status:\n"+run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout)
print("diffstat:\n"+run(["git","diff","--stat"]).stdout)
print("diff_names:\n"+run(["git","diff","--name-only"]).stdout)

p=wt/"tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
print("=== imports ===")
for i in range(min(35,len(lines))):
    print(f"{i+1}: {lines[i]}")
print("=== new tests area ===")
for i in range(max(0,len(lines)-70),len(lines)):
    print(f"{i+1}: {lines[i]}")

print("=== schema/liveness syntax ===")
for rel in ["src/do_again/core/schema.py","src/do_again/service/liveness.py"]:
    q=run(["python3","-m","py_compile",rel])
    print(rel,q.returncode,q.stderr)
